title: aubi: re-export stoa_auth::UserCredential from reader config
description:
## What
Replace the locally-defined UserCredential struct in crates/reader/src/config.rs with a re-export of stoa_auth::UserCredential.

## Why
reader's crate::config::UserCredential and stoa_auth::UserCredential have identical fields (username: String, password: String) but are different types. server_stores.rs calls CredentialStore::from_credentials(&auth.users) where auth.users: Vec<crate::config::UserCredential>. After removing the duplicate CredentialStore, from_credentials expects Vec<stoa_auth::UserCredential>. A re-export makes auth.users the correct type with zero call-site changes.

## Algorithm
1. Read /home/mark/PROJECT/stoa/crates/reader/src/config.rs — find the UserCredential struct definition.
2. Replace:
   pub struct UserCredential { pub username: String, pub password: String, }
   (and any derives/attributes) with:
   pub use stoa_auth::UserCredential;
3. Remove any now-dead derive/serde attributes that were on the local struct.
4. Verify stoa-auth is already in reader/Cargo.toml (it is).
5. Run: cargo build -p stoa-reader 2>&1; echo EXIT:$?

## Defensive rules
- If reader's AuthConfig has a 'users: Vec<UserCredential>' field, the re-export must be visible at the module level where AuthConfig is defined.
- Do not change any other config types.
- If the local UserCredential had serde attributes that stoa_auth::UserCredential lacks, check stoa_auth::UserCredential's definition first.

## Acceptance
cargo build -p stoa-reader clean; no UserCredential struct literal in reader/src/config.rs
